realm.name: platform-super-admin
realm.description: Platform owner. Only role allowed to use Keycloak Admin Console.

realm.name: store-owner
realm.description: Owner of a store. Permissions enforced in the ecommerce admin application.

realm.name: store-admin
realm.description: Store administrator. Permissions enforced in the application.

realm.name: store-editor
realm.description: Store editor. Fine-grained permissions defined in the application, not in Keycloak.

clients.name: MinIO Console
clients.description: OIDC for MinIO Console. Replace redirect host and set secret at apply time.

_comment_mfa: Require MFA for platform-super-admin and preferably all staff via authentication flows after bootstrap.
_comment_tenancy: Staff isolation uses group store-demo (and future store-* groups). Map group attribute store_id into tokens via protocol mapper at client setup.
_comment_secrets: No users, passwords, or client secrets in Git. Create bootstrap users at deploy time from the secret manager.
_comment_permissions: Keycloak stores roles only. Application services own permission maps. See docs/operations/identity-rbac-and-tenancy.md.
_comment_storage_clients: minio-console and file-service: see platform/identity/seeds/clients/ and platform/storage/docs/console-oidc.md.
